subject: english
stem: The cafe sign says OPEN, but the door is locked and no lights are on. What is most reasonable?
options: The cafe is not serving customers right now
The cafe will open again at a different time today

optionRationales.reason: The cafe is not serving customers right now：locked door 與 no lights 共同壓過 OPEN sign 的一般資訊。
鎖門且無燈只支持現在未營業，沒有證據保證今天稍後會重開。
Every worker is asleep：沒有 worker 狀態。
The sign was made today：製作日期未提。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「兩項各自不足的明示線索合併後只支持一個結果」可推出 The cafe is not serving customers right now；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The cafe is not serving customers right now 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
